Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-223-3 (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (VOUT).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (MLCC stable) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 10 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (125 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (15 V rec / 18 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
